name: URY admin sidebar
describe: Navigation rail: DayStatusCard, Plan / Operate / Observe / Control groups, a Reports disclosure and a Setup disclosure pinned to the bottom. 232px expanded, 64px collapsed; the active link is a raised card chip with a primary-coloured icon.

Left of every admin screen. Show the collapsed and Reports-open variants for those states. Arabic comes from ury/translations/ar.csv; "Plan", "Setup", the sample company, branch and department names and the sample date are translated here because ar.csv has no entry for them.
